input_sweep.note: Regulation below the 3 V datasheet test condition relies on typical dropout (model VDROP 1.7 V at ~0.1 A).

bringup_no_load.note: U1 load = divider only (~5.2 mA): below the LM317 10 mA maximum minimum-load spec; the model cannot show the resulting rise, so do not judge the regulator this way.

bringup_dummy_100ohm.note: 100 ohm 3 W dummy (~98 mA, ~1 W) stands in for the amplifier's ~91 mA.

fault_note: U1 input node shorted at 20 ms (worst case, e.g. C20 failure; D5 blocks a J6-side short). The behavioural U1 has no internal reverse path, so without D6 the reverse bias shown is what the real part's internal junctions would have to absorb.

dissipation_W.note: TO-220 at ~0.3 W: about 15-20 C rise with no heatsink (R_thetaJA ~50-65 C/W).
